title: Comparison accepts duplicate check names with distinct types
observed: The comparison check map keys on name and type, so one result can contain two checks with the same name and different types.
expected: Each mechanical check name is unique within a run so matched check sets are unambiguous.

fix.note: validateChecks rejects a repeated check name (compare.go:177, added in #67 with this finding). The existing 'duplicate check name' case renamed only the external check, so the check-set mismatch rejected it even without the guard. The new test duplicates the name on both sides and fails without the guard.
